protocol.task: 2025 quarterly LG Energy Solution facility-investment cash outflows
protocol.rules: All variants use identical immutable mandate, final financial policy, exact source validator and seller-specific preview gate. Memory changes when the preview gate is evaluated, never its final strength.
protocol.fixed_baseline: Published numeric constraints, disclosed actual/quarter content keyword rules, posted floor price and deadline ranking; no deliberately unsafe payment behavior.
protocol.history: The same verified failed-delivery refund is seeded for all variants in H06 and H07. History setup is excluded from measured tasks and separately recorded.
protocol.delivery: Controlled supplier simulator returns pinned real-source observations or documented mutations. Benchmark evaluates procurement decisions; separate browser demo measures actual model extraction.
protocol.fallback: After a known seller fails its required preview, remove that offer and compare remaining offers; at most three comparisons per task.
protocol.sample: 8 newly authored cases, two repeats. Prior set used for development; this set is frozen before its first execution. Same team authors cases, so this is not independent customer validation.
protocol.pre_registration: This file and evaluation source hashes are captured before the first call. Expected outcomes and delivery mutations are not given to the model.
protocol.phase: Development re-evaluation after known-case price-choice errors; not a fresh holdout
protocol.decision_quality: An impossible task is correct only when no task funds were locked. Safe refund is reported separately from a correct procurement decision.
protocol.selection: AI reviews every offer content with literal evidence; code ranks matching, policy-compliant posted floors.
